arguments.title: Activation target note — April 5, 2023
arguments.body:
**April 5, 2023 — Activation target**

Keep **60%** on the Q2 deck: the Q1 activation target remains active for Q2 unchanged.

**65%** is a conditional small-business-tier planning target only. It would be considered if the sub-50-seat tier ships in Q3; that future scenario is not an approved current Q2 target.
